name: The Ashlamp
description: The burnt shell of a Waykeeper waystation at the causeway head, the first thing east of Dawnmead's gate. Ruin walls breached three ways, the order's own lamp post cold in its socket, one ember bed that still smokes, the ash shovelled out the door, a stalled Charter wain under tarp, and a sign that says only what it says. Who burned it is told two ways and never settled.
